body_markdown:
Peraso Inc., a pioneer in mmWave wireless technology solutions, today announced the introduction of the “PRM2145,” a new wireless communications module specifically designed to address the requirements of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), autonomous systems, and defense communications applications.
